title: Validate before reload
summary: A configuration test can catch syntax problems before the server tries to use a new configuration. Reloading is a separate action.
introduction: A configuration test can catch syntax problems before the server tries to use a new configuration. Reloading is a separate action. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A configuration test can catch syntax problems before the server tries to use a new configuration. Reloading is a separate action.
Run this only for the configuration you are authorised to inspect. A successful syntax test does not prove all site routes work.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
List pages and asset types to check after an approved reload.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not restart or reload someone else's server while practising.
For more detail later, use this [Nginx further reading](https://nginx.org/en/docs/beginners_guide.html).

seo.title: Nginx: Validate before reload
seo.description: Learn about validate before reload in Nginx. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
